digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs output and confirmation
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs currently follow Unix silence convention, making successful writes indistinguishable from idempotent no-ops on stdout, causing agents to run follow-up `rebar show` commands to verify writes and misinterpret silent success as failure
All verbs in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must emit a one-line kubectl-style confirmation on success (past-tense verb + summary) and `no change: <reason>` on idempotent no-ops, with exit 0 both ways

Global `--quiet`/`-q` and `--output`/`-o` flags must be pre-extracted at the top-level router before partition dispatch to work uniformly on all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands)

link's existing REDIRECT record output must remain byte-identical before and after normalization including under `--quiet`, with exactly one stdout result per invocation (record only, no additional confirmation line)

Consumed seam return values like `add_dependency`'s `dict | None` REDIRECT contract must remain structurally unchanged; outcome signals are added only as parallel channels or derived from existing seam exposure without altering consumed types
Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract preserving every datum they print today with zero information loss
